    # If the version has a leading zero, increment the first part
    if leading_zero:
        version_parts[0] = str(int(version_parts[0]) + 1)
    # Otherwise, check if the last part is not zero
    elif version_parts[-1] != '0':
        # Increment the last part
        version_parts[-1] = str(int(version_parts[-1]) + 1)

    return '.'.join(version_parts)

        mapping_nodes = [node for node in nodes if isinstance(node, ruamel.yaml.nodes.MappingNode)]
        
        if len(mapping_nodes) > 1:

            merged_mapping = deep_merge_nodes(mapping_nodes)
